description:
The Marriage Gift Scheme is an initiative launched by the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (APBOCWWB).

This scheme was introduced to provide financial assistance to the daughters of construction workers in Andhra Pradesh.

The scheme was launched on 1st April 2018.

The primary objective of the Marriage Gift Scheme is to support the marriage of daughters of construction workers.

The scheme aims to reduce the financial burden on families during the marriage of their daughters.

The government has set a measurable target of providing financial assistance to at least 10,000 beneficiaries annually.

Under this scheme, a financial assistance of ₹50,000 is provided for the marriage of each eligible daughter.

The assistance is intended to help families cover various expenses related to the marriage ceremony.

Eligibility for the Marriage Gift Scheme is strictly defined.

The applicant must be a registered construction worker under the APBOCWWB.

The applicant must have a valid registration number with the board.

The daughter for whom the assistance is being claimed must be unmarried at the time of application.

The age limit for the daughter is set at a minimum of 18 years.

The income criteria for eligibility stipulates that the family income should not exceed ₹15,000 per month.

The applicant must provide proof of the marriage date which should not be more than one year from the date of application.

The application process for the Marriage Gift Scheme is straightforward.

Interested applicants must fill out the application form available on the official APBOCWWB website.

The application form can also be obtained from the local APBOCWWB office.

Applicants must submit a copy of their registration certificate as a construction worker.

Proof of the daughter's age must be provided through a birth certificate or other valid documents.

The applicant must also submit a copy of the marriage invitation or any document that confirms the marriage date.

Once the application is completed with all required documents, it should be submitted to the local APBOCWWB office.

After submission, the application will be reviewed by the concerned authorities.

The disbursement of the financial assistance is done directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The processing time for the application is typically around 30 days from the date of submission.

The financial assistance is provided in a single installment.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is implemented by the Andhra Pradesh Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board.

The board operates under the Department of Labour and Employment of the Government of Andhra Pradesh.

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the APBOCWWB office directly.

The contact number for the APBOCWWB is 0866-2475432.

The email address for inquiries is apbocwwb@gmail.com.

The scheme has seen a significant uptake since its launch.

In the first year alone, approximately 5,000 beneficiaries received assistance.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹50 crores for the scheme in the financial year 2023-2024.

This allocation reflects the government's commitment to supporting the welfare of construction workers and their families.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is part of a broader set of welfare initiatives aimed at improving the living standards of construction workers.

The scheme also aims to promote the importance of education and skill development among the daughters of construction workers.

By providing financial assistance, the government hopes to encourage families to invest in the education and empowerment of their daughters.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is a significant step towards gender equality in the context of marriage expenses.

The scheme has been well-received by the construction worker community in Andhra Pradesh.

Feedback from beneficiaries indicates that the financial assistance has alleviated some of the economic pressures associated with marriage.

The government regularly reviews the scheme to ensure its effectiveness and to make necessary adjustments based on feedback.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is promoted through various channels including local government offices and community outreach programs.

Awareness campaigns have been conducted to inform construction workers about the benefits of the scheme.

The scheme is also highlighted in various labor welfare programs organized by the government.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is an example of targeted welfare initiatives aimed at specific vulnerable groups.

The scheme aligns with the government's broader goals of social welfare and economic development.

The financial assistance provided under the scheme is non-repayable.

This means that beneficiaries do not have to repay the amount received for the marriage of their daughters.

The scheme is designed to be inclusive and accessible to all eligible construction workers in the state.

The government has made efforts to simplify the application process to encourage more beneficiaries to come forward.

The Marriage Gift Scheme is a testament to the government's commitment to supporting the families of construction workers.

The scheme is expected to continue evolving to meet the changing needs of the community.

Overall, the Marriage Gift Scheme represents a significant investment in the future of the daughters of construction workers in Andhra Pradesh.

The scheme not only provides financial assistance but also empowers families to celebrate marriages without excessive financial strain.
